_comment: The grazing animals, laid alone: more of the cows, sheep and pigs a world already has. A size said of
herds is how many arrive together rather than how big each is (`takes_as`): `colossal herds` are herds
of eight to ten. Followed by `of`, herds are made of whatever comes after it -- `herds of warden`,
`teeming colossal herds of parrot` -- four to six at a time unless a size said otherwise (Jonah, 2026-10-21).
